content:
incident-bot: Paging oncall-sre: detected regional request surge in eu-west affecting 2xx latency SLOs and increasing cost by ~35% over baseline. Auto-mitigation attempted (tiered-steer) but we see oscillation. Escalating for manual control. :rotating_light:

oncall-sre: on it, grabbing context. How widespread? traces?

alice-ops: spike from 09:12 UTC, primarily economy lane traffic; top client prefixes show heavy retry fanout.

carla-prod: customer-facing errors minimal, but token count and tail latency visible for seq>512. We should consider region pinning or throttling economy lane.

dmitri-platform: current smart-routing config:
```
policy: smart_routing_v3
priorities:
  - lane: standard
    weight: 0.7
  - lane: economy
    weight: 0.3
regional_overrides:
  eu-west:
    weight_shift: +0.15 -> economy
```
We pushed a mild shift earlier; looks like it's amplifying retries.

eva-ml: model variants m-small-quant and m-std are both in play. m-small has higher inference throughput but worse perplexity for long prompts; clients are routing to small to save cost, but it's thrashing KV cache and causing latency bumps.

oncall-sre: propose immediate mitigations in order: 1) throttle economy lane in eu-west to 60% of current allowance, 2) disable routing to m-small-quant for requests >512 tokens in eu-west, 3) open temporary quota for standard lane for top 10 enterprise keys. Can implement quick.

paul-support: heads-up to enterprise customers in eu-west group - will draft note if we take action that affects their cost/latency. No major direct errors from them yet.

alice-ops: +1 to throttling economy. Need the exact commands.

dmitri-platform: running commands now. patching policy via runtime API:```
POST /v1/runtime/policy/update
{
  "policy_id": "smart_routing_v3",
  "overrides": {
    "eu-west": {
      "lanes": {"economy": {"max_rate_pct": 60}},
      "model_filters": [{"match_tokens_gt":512, "block_model":"m-small-quant"}]
    }
  }
}
```
Applying in 30s.

incident-bot: note: automated canary will roll changes to 5% of eu-west traffic before wider rollout.

sre-shift: I'll hold canary at 5% and watch key metrics (p95 latency, error-rate, cost per token) for 3 mins.

carla-prod: enabling support message draft: "We're implementing a temporary routing adjustment in EU to stabilize latency. You may see slight throughput changes for economy-tier requests. Full update in 30m." Want to add anything?

eva-ml: include note that we disabled small-quant for long requests only, so short prompts unaffected.

paul-support: sending to affected customers now (10 orgs).

oncall-sre: canary in. 5% diverted. watching dashboards. p95 looks healthy at first glance.

(1m)

oncall-sre: p95 improved from 780ms -> 480ms on canary. cost delta small so far.

dmitri-platform: canary metrics look good. increasing to 25% for eu-west now.

sre-shift: on increasing, but hold throttles for economy at 60% until 10m stabilization window.

alice-ops: noticed some backpressure in ingress queues — we're seeing slight queue growth for economy. Is that expected with throttles?

eva-ml: yes, queues will backpressure clients; that's intended to curb load. If queue depth exceeds safety, we can enable short 429s with Retry-After header.

oncall-sre: set temporary 429 policy for economy lane over threshold 1200ms backend wait:```
PUT /v1/runtime/ratelimit
{"lane":"economy","eu-west": {"max_concurrent_wait_ms":1200,"reject_with":429}}
```
Enabled.

paul-support: two customers asked for a status update — passed on message.

carla-prod: ops ask: are we comfortable re-enabling m-small-quant for short prompts?

eva-ml: re-enable for tokens <=128 safe. I'll patch model filter to only block >512; short prompts never left.

(6m)

dmitri-platform: expanding rollout complete to 25%. p95 stable ~460ms. cost trending down. economy lane RT ops stable.

oncall-sre: summary so far: applied region-specific throttles, blocked small-quant for long prompts, enabled queue-based 429s. No customer-facing errors, latency improved.

alice-ops: next steps: monitor 30m, if stable revert explicit throttles and instead apply weight shift in policy (soft steering) to keep economics. Also create follow-up task to tune cache warming for m-small-quant to prevent future thrash.

paul-support: will keep customers updated every 15m.

eva-ml: create an eval job for long prompt quality vs m-small-quant to quantify impact; tagging as P1 for analysis.

carla-prod: oncall-sre, handoff to next shift in 20m?

oncall-sre: yep, will leave a short Handoff note here. current status: mitigations active, metrics stable, no alerts firing. Recommended follow-ups: revert hard throttle to soft weight-shift after 30m stable; run KV cache tuning; evaluate model variant gating thresholds.

sre-shift: ack, will pick this up.

incident-bot: incident closed: severity reduced to monitor-only. Recording actions in incident tracker: mitigation: regional throttle, model gating, queue 429; owner: oncall-sre; follow-ups assigned to eva-ml and dmitri-platform. :white_check_mark:

carla-prod: thanks team. good coordination.

paul-support: sending final note to affected customers with summary and expected timeline for full policy rollback.

sre-shift: taking Handoff. leaving the thread open for questions.
